meaning:
1) to drink heavily or largely, imbibe
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to imbibe

elsewhere.note: They shall tell the elders of his city, “This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”
Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat:
“Come,” say they, “I will get wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and tomorrow will be as today, great beyond measure.”
For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.
